# dsh-notify
Desktop notifications for DeepSeek-Harness (DSH) on Windows and macOS.
中文文档：README.zh-CN.md
Hand a task to DSH, switch to something else, and get pulled back only when it matters: a toast tell
s you the task is done, or that the agent is waiting on you. Click the toast to return to the app.

> Windows 10/11 and macOS. Linux loads the plugin but cannot deliver a toast;
> its settings page st
ill opens and says so.
## What it does
| Moment | Toast |

| A task finishes | `DSH · 任务完成` with the assistant's last answer |
| A task ends in an error or an

unexpected stop | `DSH · 任务已结束` |
| The agent asks you a question and nobody answers within 6 s | `D
SH · 需要你确认` with the question |
Clicking the toast, or its **打开 DeepSeek-Harness** button, brings DSH to the front. If the window is
minimized it is restored; if it was closed to the tray it is reopened. On Windows this uses the `ds
h://notify` URL handler that the desktop app already registers. On macOS the click comes from termin
al-notifier and reopens the app bundle; without it, notifications are still shown but clicking does
ier and reopens the app bundle; without it, notifications are still shown but clicking does nothing.
Toasts stay quiet while you are already looking at the app: the page reports from the browser whethe
r one of its tabs is the foreground tab of a visible window, and no toast is raised in that case. Pl
an reviews keep their own approval UI and are not announced by default.
Everything above is adjustable in **Settings → Notifications**, the plugin's own page beside General
and Models, or from its row on the Plugins page.

## Configure
Open **Settings → Notifications**, the plugin's own page in the settings panel, or **Settings → Plug
ins → this plugin** — both render the same form. It edits the `dsh-notify` row of your profile's `co
rdis.patch.yml` and applies each change immediately, with a **Send a test notification** button (whe
re delivery is available) to confirm the whole chain works.
Editing that row by hand works just as well — both write the same block. Every key is optional; the
defaults below are what an install without overrides uses.
On a Host that cannot deliver toasts — Linux, or Windows without the app's Start Menu shortcut — the
page still opens and shows the settings in effect, with a note naming the reason instead of an erro
r. The first save adds the plugin's row to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (the file the Host reads
), so a bundle install is editable; a checkout that has no profile patch stays read-only.
The plugin's own routes are loopback-only and require its `x-dsh-notify: 1` header; the desktop shel
l's `dsh-app://app` origin is accepted explicitly. A remote or LAN page therefore gets a 403 instead
//app` origin is accepted explicitly. A remote or LAN page therefore gets a 403 instead of the form.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`forked` and `interrupted` are handovers inside the app rather than a finished task, so they are not
offered as endpoints. `sound: important` keeps only the question toast audible.
## How it works
The plugin is a Cordis plugin: it exports `apply(ctx)` and registers listeners on the host context.
* **Turns** — DSH commits a `turn/end` event to each session's log. The plugin follows that feed and

raises a toast when a turn ends, skipping subagent sessions and turns you cancelled yourself.
* **Q
uestions** — the plugin watches committed `tool/call` session events and handles only calls named `a
sk_user_question`, reading the question from the tool arguments. It raises a toast after `questionDe
layMs`; an answered call cancels the pending toast, while a timed-out question that remains answerab

le does not. The plugin does not intercept the tool call or answer for you.
* **Focus** — a small sc
ript served by the host reports tab visibility and focus back to the host, which is the only reliabl

e signal for "the user can already see this".
* **Delivery** — on Windows `notify.ps1` raises the to
ast through WinRT as the app's Start Menu shortcut. Windows resolves a toast's application name from
the `AppUserModelId` registry entry, not from the toast XML, so the script (re)writes that entry be
fore each send. On macOS the Host spawns `terminal-notifier` when it is installed, and otherwise `os
ascript` (`display notification`); both are ordinary processes, so the plugin has no native dependen
cy. macOS notifications show under the helper's own name (terminal-notifier or Script Editor), which
also means the user grants notifications to that name.
## Requirements
* Windows 10 or 11 with Windows PowerShell 5.1 (present on every supported Windows), and a DeepSeek-

Harness Start Menu shortcut for the app; or
* macOS with the built-in `osascript` (every supported r
elease). `terminal-notifier` is optional and only needed for click-to-return: `brew install terminal
terminal-notifier` is optional and only needed for click-to-return: `brew install terminal-notifier`
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`notify.ps1` must keep its UTF-8 BOM. Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads a `.ps1` file in the system code
page unless a BOM says otherwise, and the action label is Chinese — without the BOM it renders as mo
jibake. The test suite checks this.
## Releasing
Pushing a `v*` tag stages that version on npm; a normal push only runs the tests.
